title: Optimizing Sleep Hygiene for Cardiovascular Health
summary: Consistent 7-8 hours of quality sleep reduces cortisol, stabilizes blood pressure, and improves immune defense.
keyPoints: Keep a fixed sleep-wake schedule even on weekends.
Limit blue light exposure 60 minutes before bedtime.
Keep bedroom temperature between 18°C - 21°C for optimal melatonin synthesis.

title: Heart-Smart Diet: Mediterranean Eating Patterns
summary: Emphasizing healthy unsaturated fats, fiber-rich legumes, and colorful vegetables drastically reduces LDL cholesterol.
keyPoints: Replace saturated fats with extra virgin olive oil, nuts, and seeds.
Target at least 25-30 grams of dietary fiber daily.
Reduce ultra-processed foods and sodium intake to under 2,000 mg/day.

title: 150 Minutes of Moderate Aerobic Activity Weekly
summary: Brisk walking, cycling, or swimming strengthens the myocardium, enhances insulin sensitivity, and elevates mood.
keyPoints: Split into 30-minute sessions across 5 days a week.
Include twice-weekly resistance training for bone mineral density.
Warm up and stretch before engaging in high-intensity workouts.

title: Essential Annual Health Screenings by Age Group
summary: Early detection saves lives. Routine blood panels, blood pressure monitoring, and cancer screenings prevent severe complications.
keyPoints: Ages 20-39: Annual BP, lipid profile every 3-5 years, fasting glucose.
Ages 40-49: Annual cardiac assessment, mammograms for women, diabetes screening.
Ages 50+: Colonoscopy, bone density DEXA scans, prostate and cardiac monitoring.

title: Hydration, Posture & Digital Eye Strain Management
summary: Practical daily ergonomics to protect your cervical spine and maintain peak cognitive alertness.
keyPoints: Follow the 20-20-20 rule: Every 20 mins look at an object 20 feet away for 20 seconds.
Keep your computer screen eye-level to prevent forward head posture.
Drink 2.5 - 3 liters of water throughout the day.

title: Recognizing Red-Flag Symptoms That Require Prompt Medical Attention
summary: Clear indicators when home remedies are not suitable and professional medical evaluation is crucial.
keyPoints: Sudden crushing chest pressure, shortness of breath, or radiating jaw/arm pain (Emergency).
Persistent fever lasting over 3 days or unexplained sudden weight loss.
Sudden weakness on one side of face/arm or slurred speech (FAST stroke sign).
Severe abdominal pain accompanied by persistent vomiting.
